rules.c_check: a burst counts for the registered scores only if every launch of it (the calibration launch included) has a C record and reads PASS in ccheck.py check (bit-exact against Q139(k)'s reference); ROUNDING, UNMODELLED, FAIL and a missing record are not checked

dma.rule: the smoke's median launch gap less E143's smoke median is the C log's extra time per launch (delta); the session runs only if E143's longest device-held time (s1) + 17 x delta <= 7.2 s, else QUEUE-HALT
